o.text: Morphologically yol (“road”) + -daş (“fellow, sharer”). Cognate with Kipchak یولداش (“travelling companion”).

glosses: howl (protracted, mournful cry of an animal)
graft (small shoot or scion of a tree inserted in another tree)
plow beam (wooden structural element connecting the plow to the yoke)

o.text: From dialectal ula- (“joint, connect, to attach”) + -ma.
